semiconductor_relevance: High — Adtec Engineering specializes in exposure equipment, which is critical for semiconductor lithography processes.
summary: Adtec Engineering is a leading provider of exposure equipment for the semiconductor industry, focusing on both contact-type and maskless exposure systems. Established in 1983, the company has developed advanced technologies that cater to high-density IC packaging and ultra-precision machining.
capabilities: Maskless exposure systems with 2µm L/S & 1µm Overlay capabilities
Automatic Protective Film Removal Device for difficult-to-peel materials
Direct Write exposure systems for fan-out processes
